title: [1.8.1] Cobblemon Cobbletwo - Best Cobblemon Experience
description: Pokemon Cobblemon Pack - QoL and Performance mods! The server included in the pack has Every Pokemon, Mega Evolution and Legendary Spawns, Player Gyms, Raids, GTS, Pokemon Fishing, Races and more!
body:
![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fe8a2510a4e50436a9ec4458ea58d6ebf738e64.png)
![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1557680256972890143/1557680284785319986/c2sep.png?ex=6ac8ae50&is=6ac75cd0&hm=dfb16ef5ea07e69a24ea1bf16767c2a10365806470fd08a3c1848405299fb974&)

### Server Features
- Take your **Shiny Starter**, your backpack and your Pokédex today!
- **Mount** your favorite Pokémon, and increase your friendship with it.
- Battle against **Gym** leaders to get every medal and become the Pokémon Champion!
- Get Free ranks and crate keys by voting and being active on the server!
- D-did you hear that r-roar? Yeah, legendary Pokémon spawns here and there.
- Join the Pokémon GO-style **Raids** to catch the Boss and get yummy rewards!

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1557680256972890143/1557680284785319986/c2sep.png?ex=6ac8ae50&is=6ac75cd0&hm=dfb16ef5ea07e69a24ea1bf16767c2a10365806470fd08a3c1848405299fb974&)

### QoL Mods
- [Better Statistics Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-stats): Enhances Minecraft's statistics screen with a more user-friendly UI, filters, and a search field for easier navigation and tracking of numerous entries.
- [Bobby](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby): Allows for render distances beyond the server's view-distance setting.
- [Continue Button](https://modrinth.com/mod/continue): Creates a button on the main menu screen that allows you to quickly load into the previous world or server you were playing on.
- [Durability Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/durability-plus): Adds simple and elegant item durability tooltips.
- [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity): Allows for efficient connected textures
- [Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps): Reduce resource usage while Minecraft is in the background or idle.
- [Dynamic Crosshair](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamiccrosshair): Hides or changes the crosshair dependent on context
- [Emoji Type](https://modrinth.com/mod/emoji-type): Allows you to easily type emoji and emoticons in game.
- [Iris Shaders ](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris): A modern shaders mod for Minecraft intended to be compatible with existing OptiFine shader packs.
- [Falling Leaves](https://modrinth.com/mod/fallingleaves): Adds a neat little particle effect to leaf blocks.
- [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap): Displays a map of the nearby world terrain, players, mobs, entities in the corner of your screen. Lets you create waypoints which help you find the locations you've marked.
- [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map): Adds a full screen world map which shows you what you have explored in the world.
- [Roughly Enough Items (REI)](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei): Alternative to Just Enough Items/JEI.
- [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify): A zoom mod with infinite customizability.
- [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat): A working voice chat in Minecraft!
- [Crafting Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/crafting-tweaks): Allows you to rotate, balance or clear the crafting matrix by the press of a button.
- [Inventory Essentials](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-essentials): Basic inventory tweaks. Lightweight and compatible.
- [Wakes](https://modrinth.com/mod/wakes): Adds splashes and wakes while traveling on water.
- [Advancement Plaques](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancement-plaques): Replace the advancement popups with fancy glowing plaques.
- [InvMove](https://modrinth.com/mod/invmove): Adds the ability to walk around while in inventories.
- [Better Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-advancements): Improve the UI and UX for the advancements system.
- [Symbol Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/symbol-chat): Adds a symbol/emoji menu as well as writing in different unicode fonts.
- [Dark Loading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/dark-loading-screen): Makes the loading screen darker.
- [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade): Shows information about what you are looking at.
- [Better Third Person](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-third-person): Improves third person camera view.
- [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin): Food/hunger-related HUD improvements
- [CraftPresence](https://modrinth.com/mod/craftpresence): Completely customize the way others see you play in Discord!
- [Visuality](https://modrinth.com/mod/visuality): Little visual improvements by adding a bunch of new particles.

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1557680256972890143/1557680284785319986/c2sep.png?ex=6ac8ae50&is=6ac75cd0&hm=dfb16ef5ea07e69a24ea1bf16767c2a10365806470fd08a3c1848405299fb974&)

### Performance & Fixes Mods
- [Adaptive Tooltips](https://modrinth.com/mod/adaptive-tooltips): Highly configurable tooltip rendering, so you can always read them!
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling): Using async path-tracing to hide Block-/Entities that are not visible.
- [Enhanced Block Entities](https://modrinth.com/mod/ebe): 
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium): A modern rendering engine for Minecraft which greatly improves performance.
- [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra): A Sodium addon that adds features that shouldn't be in Sodium.
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium): No-compromises game logic/server optimization mod.
- [Indium](https://modrinth.com/mod/indium): Sodium addon providing support for the Fabric Rendering API, based on Indigo
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core): Memory usage optimizations
- [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast): Speed up immediate mode rendering in Minecraft
- [More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling): Changes how multiple types of culling are handled in order to improve performance
- [Title Fix Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/title-fix-mod): When exiting a world or server, the in game title overlay will be cleared to prevent transferring to the next world.
- [Item Model Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-model-fix): Fixes gaps in generated item models.
- [Chat Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/chatpatches): Touches up a few aspects of Minecraft's mundane chat, with as much configurability as possible!
- [Krypton](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton): Mod to optimize the Minecraft networking stack.
- [LazyDFU](https://modrinth.com/mod/lazydfu): Makes the game boot faster by deferring non-essential initialization.

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1557680256972890143/1557680284785319986/c2sep.png?ex=6ac8ae50&is=6ac75cd0&hm=dfb16ef5ea07e69a24ea1bf16767c2a10365806470fd08a3c1848405299fb974&)

### Resource/Shader Packs
- [Cobblemon Interface](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cobblemon-interface): Makes Minecraft's interface and sounds fit the Cobblemon mod aesthetics.
- [Cobblemon Emissive Ores](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cobblemon-emissive-ores): Help you find those tough-to-see ores lurking in water, or on the cave roof.
- [Cobblemon Classic Grass Pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cobblemon-classic-grass-pack): Replaces the grass to a more inspired in Pokémon.
and the minecraft tall grass replacement texture is highly inspired by
the long grass from Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire & Emerald.
- [Cobblemon - GS Apricorn Leaves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cobblemon-gs-apricorn-leaves): Replaces the Cobblemon Apricorn leaves with a softer texture.
- [3D Crops Revamped](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/3d-crops): Simply turns your crops into 3D blocks!
- [PokePlaques](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pokeplaques-cobblemon): Integrates with the Advancement Plaques mod bringing a new Pokémon themed achievements GUI.
- [Round Trees](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/round-trees): Trees are round in real life, why aren't they in Minecraft?
- [Motschen's Better Leaves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/better-leaves): Makes the leaves bushy.
- [BSL Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/bsl-shaders): Shaderpack for Minecraft: Java Edition. It's bright, colorful, and distinct.
- [Complementary Shaders - Unbound](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound): Transforming the visuals of Minecraft with exceptional quality, detail, and performance.
- [Complementary Shaders - Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined): Preserving the elements of Minecraft with exceptional quality, detail, and performance.
- [Kappa Shader](https://modrinth.com/shader/kappa-shader): A high-quality realistic, yet also somewhat stylized shaderpack.

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1557680256972890143/1557680284785319986/c2sep.png?ex=6ac8ae50&is=6ac75cd0&hm=dfb16ef5ea07e69a24ea1bf16767c2a10365806470fd08a3c1848405299fb974&)
